correctness.rationale: Coordinate-permutation orbit barycenters correspond to full Hamming-weight layers. Exact maximum between layers a,b is min(a+b,2n-a-b), so eligible layers at radius n-2 are weights 0..m-1 and n-m+1..n, m=floor(n/2). Within each side all layers are compatible; across low L_i/high R_j the obstruction is |i-j|<=1. Thus fixed locus is independence complex of bipartite band graph B_m. Folding dominated vertices L_{2j+1}, R_{2j+1} using L_{2j},R_{2j} leaves ceil(m/2) disjoint edges, giving cross-polytope boundary S^(ceil(m/2)-1)=S^floor((n-2)/4). Complement exchanges L_i,R_i, no fixed simplex, and reduced Lefschetz trace gives (-1)^ceil(m/2). All n>=2 boundaries give S^0 where appropriate. Fresh direct original-word layer compatibility for n=2..9 and 30 fold tests matched, finite corroboration only.
residual_risks: The homotopy equivalence through a simplicial collapse does not assert original fixed space PL-homeomorphic to a sphere.
